To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) we developed a novel 2D and a 3D automatic registration algorithm using a new similarity measure, (ii) we validated our approach with an extensive clinical study showing a high percentage of optimal registration, and (iii) our method outperformed the state-of-the-art.
we developed two automatic registration approaches that align pre-operative MRI images with intra-operative US images.
we present two automatic ultrasound-MRI image registration algorithms using LC(2) that allow an accurate and robust registration.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a novel registration method for neurosurgical image guided interventions.
the development of automatic image registration algorithms to align pre-interventional MRI and intra-operative US images for image guided neurosurgical interventions.
the automatic registration of US and MRI images for neurosurgical interventions.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the presented method provides an accurate and robust registration of US and MRI images, which is a crucial prerequisite for image guided neurosurgical interventions.
the presented algorithms are robust, accurate and precise and can be successfully used to align US images and MRI for image guided neurosurgical interventions.
the presented algorithms provide a fast, robust, and accurate automatic registration method for the use in neurosurgery.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
our algorithms can be used to align US images to MRI images with high accuracy, robustness and speed.
the 3D method is more accurate and more robust than the 2D approach.
our method allows a fully automatic registration of MRI and US images with high robustness and accuracy, which is a prerequisite for a reliable image guided surgery.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the LC(2) Metric is a promising similarity measure for ultrasound-MRI registration in neurosurgery, which is easy to implement, robust and computationally efficient.
automatic ultrasound-MRI registration is a promising technique for intra-operative image guidance in neurosurgery.
the LC(2) metric can be used to register 2D and especially 3D US volumes to MRI.
